name: humid_air_1691_whf_wetter_than_house_paused
description: Outdoor dew point 58F against a 55F house (outdoor air wetter than the house, below the ceiling): no fan start
notes: Dew points (feels_like.dew_point_f): indoor 76.0F at 48.2% = 55.0F; outdoor 64.0F at 80.9% = 58.02F. Ceiling = default 65F (option On).

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: deleting the relative clause (or the guard) makes 20:10 read natural_ventilation. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: the fan would raise the house's dew point by ~3F; the occupant feels it as clammy air.

Issue #1507 review: the outdoor humidity is paired with a dedicated outdoor temperature sensor (outdoor_temp_source sensor), as a real install needs for an outdoor dew point, so the coordinator-hosted golden tiers (P8 surfaces, promise parity, real HA) can run this scenario.

verdict.summary: Outdoor dew point 58F against a 55F house (outdoor air wetter than the house, below the ceiling): no fan start
